QuestInfo.name: Beldar's Entreaty
QuestInfo.0: Beldar, of the Pantheon Council, is contacting you.
QuestInfo.1: Beldar's got work for you in Pantheon. Looks like it's time to meet up with him.
QuestInfo.2: The Pantheon council recently decided to form a friendly relationship with the Cygnus Knights in Maple World, and Beldar needed your help, of course.

0.msg: Pantheon is in need of a champion of justice! Please visit us here and speak with me.\r\n#r#e* If you accept, you will move to Pantheon.#n#k
You may claim to be a rough and tumble rebel, but I know deep down you can't ignore injustice when you see it. Help me out.

1.msg: #b(...I seem to have become some great paragon of justice.)#k

2.msg: #b(But I suppose helping out the Pantheon council would earn me a few favors in the long run. I guess I could go to Pantheon.)#k

0.msg: #b(Since you're the best fighter in town, Beldar naturally asked for your help. Sounds like a lot of work though. It would be so much easier to pretend you never got the invitation.)#k

1.0: Oh, thank you for coming! Have you made any progress in the new world? I must tell you something incredibly important.

0.msg: I'm sure you've already heard the rumors, but the Pantheon council is going to form a friendly relationship with the Cygnus Knights in Maple World. It's because we have common enemy called Magnus.

1.msg: It seems they also have a powerful enemy similar to ours. We decided to cooperate, since they seem to be quite organized in opposing their own foe.

2.msg: I thought you could use this information, since you're active in Maple World. If you're interested, I can also introduce you to them.

3.msg: What do you think? Let me know when you've decided.

4.msg: #b(You weren't really looking to join any causes, but this would be more efficient.)#k

default.0: Pantheon is in need of a champion of justice! Please visit us here and chat with me.
